correctness.rationale: With normalized weighted Bergman measure dμ_α=(α−1)(1−|z|²)^(α−2)dA/π, α>1, the monomial moments μ_n=n!/(α)_n are the correct normalization. Orthogonality yields ||f(r·)||_4^4=Σ μ_n r^(2n)|Σ_{k=0}^n c_kc_{n−k}|². At r²=1/2 the quadratic deficit in a cancels identically. For f=1+az+h, h=Σ_{n>=2}b_nz^n, decompose f²=P+R with P=1+2az+a²z²+2h and R=2azh+h². R has no degrees 0,1,2, preventing cross-terms with the constant/critical mode. Completing the square gives exactly |a|^4/[α²(α+1)]+μ_2|b2−a²/2|²+Σ_{n>=3}(2−2^{2−n})μ_n|b_n|², where μ_2=2/[α(α+1)]. The dilation reproducing kernel bounds ||h(r·)||∞ by C_α||h||₂, and cross-tail orthogonality bounds the remainder by C_α(|a|+H+(|a|+H)²)H²+O(|a|²H²+H⁴), hence little-o of |a|⁴+H² uniformly over all high modes. The positive form controls this scale; the rigidity iff b2=a²/2+o(a²), higher-mode H=o(a²) follows. The affine comparison coefficient is (α+2)/[2α²(α+1)]. Source checks/check.py uses exact rational complex coefficients and derives the structural remainder; independently checked first moments and square completion. Finite checks are not the infinite-dimensional proof. This is a local fixed-α theorem, not global stability.

value.rationale: At the sharp contractivity radius the first-mode quadratic variation vanishes: ordinary Hessian stability is inadequate. The exact quartic normal form identifies the unique nonlinear tangent direction of least deficit and measures each higher mode, a mathematically natural degeneracy/stability invariant. It distinguishes the finite-weight effect from Gaussian scaling and is more than a Taylor calculation on an arbitrary polynomial because the proof controls infinitely many analytic modes uniformly.

limitations: Fixed α>1 and local 2-to-4 r=1/sqrt(2) regime only. No global perturbation inequality, global equality classification, or uniform α limit.
Exact finite rational polynomial tests only corroborate analytic Hilbert-space control.
